title: trie Module
content_markdown: Trie is a module for efficiently caching and lookup of a set of prefixes ( stored in a trie data structure )
overview: Trie is a module for efficiently caching and lookup of a set of prefixes ( stored in a trie data structure )

dependencies_required.name: a database module
dependencies_required.reason: must be loaded before this module

exported_parameters.name: trie_table
exported_parameters.description: The name of the db table storing prefix rules.

exported_parameters.name: no_concurrent_reload
exported_parameters.description:
If enabled, the module will not allow do run multiple trie\_reload MI commands in parallel (with overlapping) Any new reload will be rejected (and discarded) while an existing reload is in progress.

If you have a large routing set (millions of rules/prefixes), you should consider disabling concurrent reload as they will exhaust the shared memory (by reloading into memory, in the same time, multiple instances of routing data).
exported_parameters.example_code:
# do not allow parallel reload operations
modparam("trie", "no\_concurrent\_reload", 1)

exported_parameters.name: use_partitions
exported_parameters.description: Flag to configure whether to use partitions for tries. If this flag is set then the `db_partitions_url` and `db_partitions_table` variables become mandatory.

exported_parameters.name: db_partitions_url
exported_parameters.description: The url to the database containing partition-specific information.The `use_partitions` parameter must be set to 1.

exported_parameters.name: db_partitions_table
exported_parameters.description: The name of the table containing partition definitions. To be used with `use_partitions` and `db_partitions_url`.

exported_parameters.name: extra_prefix_chars
exported_parameters.description: List of ASCII (0-127) characters to be additionally accepted in the prefixes. By default only '0' - '9' chars (digits) are accepted.

exported_functions.name: trie_search

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: number to be searched in the trie

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: a list of letter-like flags for controlling the routing behavior. Possible flags are:

parameters.name: trie_attrs_pvar
parameters.description: a writable variable which will be populated with the attributes of the matched trie rule.

parameters.name: match_prefix_pvar
parameters.description: a writable variable which will be the actual prefix matched in the trie.

parameters.name: partition
parameters.description: the name of the trie partition to be used. This parameter is to be defined ONLY if the "use_partition" module parameter is turned on.

exported_functions.description:
Function to search for an entry ( number ) in a trie.

This function can be used from all routes.

If you set `use_partitions` to 1 the **partition** last parameter becomes mandatory.

All parameters are optional. Any of them may be ignored, provided the necessary separation marks "," are properly placed.

exported_mi_functions.name: trie_reload

parameters.name: partition_name
parameters.description: if not provided all the partitions will be reloaded, otherwise just the partition given as parameter will be reloaded.

exported_mi_functions.description:
Command to reload trie rules from database.

* if `use_partition` is set to 0 - all routing rules will be reloaded.
* if `use_partition` is set to 1, the parameters are:
    * _partition_name_ (optional) - if not provided all the partitions will be reloaded, otherwise just the partition given as parameter will be reloaded.

exported_mi_functions.name: trie_reload_status

parameters.name: partition_name
parameters.description: if not provided the function will list the time of the last update for every partition. Otherwise, the function will list the time of the last reload for the given partition.

return_value.description: It will list the date of the last reload for the default (and only) partition.

exported_mi_functions.description:
Gets the time of the last reload for any partition.

* if `use_partition` is set to 0 - the function doesn't receive any parameter. It will list the date of the last reload for the default (and only) partition.
* if `use_partition` is set to 1, the parameters are:
    * _partition_name_ (optional) - if not provided the function will list the time of the last update for every partition. Otherwise, the function will list the time of the last reload for the given partition.

examples.code:
$ opensips-cli -x mi trie\_reload\_status
Date:: Tue Aug 12 12:26:00 2014

exported_mi_functions.name: trie_search
exported_mi_functions.description:
Tries to match a number in the existing tries loaded from the database.

* if `use_partition` is set to 1 the function will have 2 parameters:
    * _partition_name_
    * _number_ - the number to test against
* if `use_partition` is set to 0 the function will have 1 parameter:
    * _number_ - the number to test against

exported_mi_functions.name: trie_number_delete

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: the array of numbers to delete

exported_mi_functions.description:
Deletes individual entries in the trie, without reloading all of the data

* if `use_partition` is set to 1 the function will have 2 parameters:
    * _partition_name_
    * _number_ - the array of numbers to delete

exported_mi_functions.name: trie_number_upsert

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: the array of numbers to update

parameters.name: attrs
parameters.description: the array of new attributes for the numbers

exported_mi_functions.description:
Upserts ( insert if not found, update is found ) an array of numbers in the trie, without reloading all of the data

* if `use_partition` is set to 1 the function will have 3 parameters:
    * _partition_name_
    * _number_ - the array of numbers to update
    * _attrs_ - the array of new attributes for the numbers

examples.code: opensips-cli -x mi trie\_number\_upsert partition\_name=part1 number=\["012340987"\] attrs=\["my\_attrs"\]
